Its torsion-free kernel is the stated K_i. The literal root equations w^(m_i)=u and x=s^(N/m_i)/w give total covering degree m_i, and summing all lifted singular chains yields intersection scaling by m_i. The receiving two real horizontal flows then put every compact transferred cycle in one nearby torus over the whole small disc, giving Psi and its monodromy-invariant image. Huybrechts gives K3 inertia(3,19); Peters' actual blowdown pullback plus exceptional class adds one orthogonal(-1) per point. Enriques c1^2=0,pg=b1=0 give e12,b2=10,signature-8, hence(1,9); UN33 supplies the same stated numerical inputs for the relevant elliptic case. The receiving negative-index inequalities give boundary ranks16+n and6+n. The current rational wedge certificate is identified with the printed rank-two basis by column order(1,4,2,3) and last-column factor(-epsilon).
